page: Microsoft Azure E32ds_v7 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Edsv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor with 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The processor is equipped with 48 KB L1d cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and a large 480 MB L3 cache. It supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 (AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, AVX512_BF16) and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX_TILE, AMX_INT8). The server is provisioned with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per core, and includes 1890 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capability. No GPUs are included.

Benchmark evaluations place the E32ds_v7 in the average performance tier for most standard operations, with notable strengths in specific workloads. The system achieves a stress-ng single-core CPU performance score of 2238.28 and a multi-core score of 34203.68. Memory bandwidth tests show a cached read-only small block rate of 2417.14 GB/sec, while uncached large block read and write speeds reach 146.04 GB/sec and 62.52 GB/sec, respectively. In compression tasks, the server demonstrates strong performance, registering a single-threaded gzip compression speed of 36.05 GB/sec, which falls into the top 25% tier. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches 180.33 GB/sec. For database operations, the server processes 53.04 million Redis SET operations per second and scores 14087.31 on PassMark database benchmarks. Large language model inference speeds are average for medium 7B models but drop to a weak 2.69 tokens/sec for text generation on large 70B models.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8 and the inclusion of 1890 GB of local storage, the E32ds_v7 offers a resource-dense profile suitable for memory-intensive enterprise workloads without the added cost of external storage overhead. The presence of advanced vector and matrix extensions provides hardware-level acceleration for mathematical and cryptographic operations, compensating for the lack of dedicated GPU hardware in non-extreme AI inference tasks. This server is best suited for relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, data warehousing, and medium-scale analytical workloads that require substantial memory capacity and fast local storage.

Built on the x86_64 architecture with Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization, it features 256.0 GB of RAM and 1890 GB of local storage with Premium Storage support. The processor includes a 480 MB L3 cache and supports AVX-512 and Intel AMX instructions. Performance benchmarks show average multi-core capabilities with a stress-ng score of 34203.68, alongside strong single-threaded gzip compression at 36.05 GB/sec. It handles database operations efficiently, processing 53.04 million Redis SET operations per second. Lacking a GPU, it is less suited for large-scale LLM text generation but excels in memory-intensive applications, relational databases, in-memory caching, and data analysis.
